comparison.objective: Sort colored cubes while responding to a high-level alarm by closing an inlet.
comparison.physical_skill: Discrete pick-and-place classification interleaved with time-critical valve operation.
comparison.success_condition: Cubes in color-matched bins and inlet closed after alarm but before overflow; overflow fails.
comparison.reason: Appearance-based discrete sorting plus alarm response does not test geometry-based separation of a mixture through physical apertures. No material rubric detail is missing.
